definitions.explanation: Describes something that is capable of being moved or set into motion, as opposed to being fixed in place. Often used in technical, medical, and engineering contexts.

examples.japanese: {可動|かどう}{式|しき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{可動橋|かどうきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: This bridge is a movable bridge that opens when ships pass through.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可動|かどう}⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}く→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The range of motion of this joint has narrowed.

notes:
Describes something that can be moved or set into motion. Composed of {可|か} (able/possible) + {動|どう} (move). Used as a modifier before nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or in compound words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可動|かどう}⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧: range of motion
- {可動|かどう}{式|しき}: movable type/style
- {可動橋|かどうきょう}: movable bridge, drawbridge
- {可動|かどう}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: moving parts
- {可動|かどう}⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: adjustable/movable shelves

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{稼働|かどう}→稼働：16938_kadou⟧: operation/running — a homophone but means being in active operation (machines, factories)
- ⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧: movement/transfer — the act of moving from one place to another
- ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧: fixed/stationary — the opposite of {可動|かどう}
